caption:
The Bible stays shut to you. You read the words and feel nothing — because you've been meeting the page, not the One who wrote it. (Galatians 3:8 devotional)

Scripture "foresaw" and "preached the gospel beforehand" to Abraham — and only a living Author can foresee. The whole Book turns out to be one Author telling one story: Him. So when you read leaning on His intent instead of just decoding letters, it opens.
